items.stem: In n8n, how does data generally get from one node to the next?

options.text: Through the connection, with fields referenced via expressions/mapping
options.rationale: Correct: nodes pass items along connections and later nodes map fields explicitly.

options.text: By global variables shared automatically everywhere
options.rationale: n8n passes items along connections, not implicit globals.

options.text: Only by writing to an external database between every node
options.rationale: A database is not required to pass data between nodes.

options.text: It does not; each node runs in isolation with no input
options.rationale: Downstream nodes receive the previous node's items.

items.explanation: Correct: nodes pass items along connections and later nodes map fields explicitly.

items.stem: Which TWO make an n8n workflow production-ready? (Select TWO.)

options.text: An error branch that handles a node failure gracefully
options.rationale: Correct: an error path keeps one failure from silently breaking the run.

options.text: Credentials stored in n8n's credential store, not in node fields
options.rationale: Correct: using the credential store keeps secrets out of plain-text parameters.

options.text: Hard-coding the API key into every HTTP node
options.rationale: Plain-text secrets in nodes are a leak risk.

options.text: Removing all error handling to simplify the canvas
options.rationale: Dropping error handling makes the workflow fragile.

items.explanation: Correct: an error path keeps one failure from silently breaking the run.

items.stem: An AI node in your workflow sometimes returns malformed output. What is the right next step?

options.text: Validate and handle the output before the downstream node uses it
options.rationale: Correct: AI output is untrusted and must be validated before use.

options.text: Feed it straight into the next node and hope it parses
options.rationale: Passing malformed data downstream causes silent failures.
Removing the node is not handling its output.

options.text: Disable logging so the error is not visible
options.rationale: Hiding the error does not fix the malformed output.

items.explanation: Correct: AI output is untrusted and must be validated before use.
